description: Global 1km Resolution Solar Photovoltaic Resource,Technical,and Economic Potential:Raster Datasets,Country-Level Statistics and Google Earth Engine Code is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Boxiong Su, Mingquan Wu (Chinese Academy of Sciences). DescriptionThis dataset accompanies the study “Global Fine-Scale Assessment of the Technical and Economic Potential of Solar Photovoltaic Power Using Google Earth Engine”, providing geospatial data products and code to support replication and further analysis. Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
